hints.title: Continuous Search Range
hints.text: The answer lies between the minimum and maximum elements of the array. Test whether a target average is achievable.

hints.title: Transform to Zero-Sum Subarray
hints.text: Subtracting candidate average mid from each element reduces the condition to finding a contiguous slice of length at least k with sum greater than or equal to zero.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Feasibility Check
hints.text: Iterate with the subtracted values, maintaining prefix sum and the minimum prefix sum seen up to index i minus k. If current prefix minus minimum prefix is at least zero, the candidate average is feasible.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of elements in nums
complexity.notes: Binary search on candidate average combined with prefix difference check.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating every contiguous subarray of length at least k costs O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Checking feasibility in O(N) time avoids storing all subarray averages.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Transform subarray average >= mid into sum(nums[i] - mid) >= 0 and maintain minimum prefix sum.
